fns.desc: In crypto_cipher_encrypt's CRYPTO_CIPHER_ALG_DES case, `ctx->u.des3.cbc[j] ^= plain[j]` mistakenly XORs into the unrelated des3 union member instead of `ctx->u.des.cbc[j]` (a copy-paste bug from the 3DES case above). This means the real des.cbc IV/chain state is never XORed with the plaintext before des_block_encrypt is called, breaking CBC chaining for single-DES encryption (the ciphertext no longer properly depends on the plaintext via CBC feedback) while crypto_cipher_decrypt's DES path correctly uses ctx->u.des.cbc, making encrypt/decrypt asymmetric/broken for this algorithm.
